projects.document: Aarambh Skyline Greens is a apartment project in Sector 150, Noida (Noida Expressway). 3-side open towers on the Noida Expressway, wrapped in 8 acres of green. Price band ₹95 Lakh – ₹2.8 Crore. Status: under construction. Possession: Phase 1 (Towers A & B): December 2027 · Phase 2 (Towers C & D): June 2028. Suited to: self use, investment, both buyers. Amenities include 45,000 sq ft clubhouse, Olympic-length swimming pool + kids' pool, 7-a-side football turf, Indoor badminton & squash courts, Fully equipped gym and yoga deck, Co-working lounge and business centre, Amphitheatre and party lawn, Kids' play zone and creche, EV charging on every basement level, 80% open landscaped area, 3-tier security with boom barriers and CCTV, Rainwater harvesting and STP. Nearby: Noida–Greater Noida Expressway (5 min drive), Aqua Line Metro (Sector 148) (~10 min), Advant / Oxygen Business Park (15 min), Noida International Airport, Jewar (~35 min), Shiv Nadar & Amity University (20–25 min), Proposed Sector 150 sports city & golf course (Adjacent). Why buyers choose it: Sector 150 is the lowest-density sector in Noida — roughly 80% is reserved as green and sports area Only 4 apartments per floor, all 3-side open Under-construction pricing sits below ready stock in Sector 128 and 135

Aarambh Riverfront Residences is a apartment project in Sector 128, Noida (Noida Expressway (Premium)). Low-density luxury with uninterrupted golf-course and river views. Price band ₹3.2 Crore – ₹6.5 Crore. Status: ready to move. Possession: Ready to move — OC received, immediate registry possible. Suited to: self use, both buyers. Amenities include Private 9-hole golf course access, Riverside jogging and cycling trail, Temperature-controlled infinity pool, Spa, salon, steam and sauna, Private theatre and cigar lounge, Concierge and valet parking, Fine-dining restaurant within the complex, 5-tier security with facial recognition. Nearby: DND Flyway to South Delhi (20 min), Botanical Garden Metro (Blue + Magenta) (12 min), DLF Mall of India / Sector 18 (15 min), Jaypee Hospital (8 min). Why buyers choose it: Ready to move with OC — no construction risk and no GST on purchase Only 2 apartments per floor Rental yield in this pocket has historically been 2.8–3.2% (past performance, not a guarantee)

Aarambh Villa Grande is a villa project in Sector 151, Noida (Noida Expressway). Independent villas with private lawns, inside a gated 22-acre estate. Price band ₹4.5 Crore – ₹7.8 Crore. Status: under construction. Possession: Phase 1: September 2027 · Phase 2: March 2028. Suited to: self use, both buyers. Amenities include Private lawn and terrace with every villa, Provision for a private plunge pool, Estate clubhouse with pool and gym, Golf putting green, Dedicated servant quarters, 4-car covered parking, Underground utilities — no overhead cabling, 24x7 estate security with patrolling. Nearby: Noida–Greater Noida Expressway (7 min), Sector 150 sports city (5 min), Noida International Airport, Jewar (30 min), Aqua Line Metro (Sector 148) (12 min). Why buyers choose it: Land ownership with the villa, not just an apartment share Only 84 villas on 22 acres Ceiling height of 11 ft on the ground floor

Aarambh Studio One is a apartment project in Sector 140A, Noida (Noida Expressway). Compact studios built for rental yield, beside the Noida IT belt. Price band ₹28 Lakh – ₹48 Lakh. Status: ready to move. Possession: Ready to move — possession within 30 days of registry. Suited to: investment buyers. Amenities include Fully furnished — bed, wardrobe, kitchenette, AC, Managed rental programme (optional), Rooftop cafe and lounge, Compact gym, High-speed fibre in every unit, Power backup and lift, Housekeeping available on subscription. Nearby: Advant Navis Business Park (6 min), Oxygen Business Park (9 min), Aqua Line Metro (Sector 142) (8 min), Noida–Greater Noida Expressway (3 min). Why buyers choose it: Lowest entry ticket in the portfolio Sold furnished, so it can be let out immediately Walking distance to two large business parks — the tenant pool is IT staff

Aarambh Corporate Square is a commercial project in Sector 62, Noida (Noida Central). Grade-A offices and high-street retail in Noida's established business sector. Price band ₹55 Lakh – ₹3.5 Crore. Status: ready to move. Possession: Ready to move — fit-out can begin immediately. Suited to: investment buyers. Amenities include Double-height air-conditioned lobby, 6 high-speed passenger lifts + service lift, 100% DG power backup, Two-level basement parking, Food court and cafeteria, Conference and meeting rooms on demand, 24x7 access with card entry. Nearby: Blue Line Metro (Sector 62 / Electronic City) (6 min walk), Fortis Hospital (5 min), NH-24 / Delhi–Meerut Expressway (4 min), Sector 18 market (18 min). Why buyers choose it: Sector 62 is an established office market — no waiting for the area to develop Metro entrance is a six-minute walk, which drives retail footfall Commercial yields here have historically run higher than residential (past performance, not a guarantee)

Aarambh Pinnacle is a apartment project in Sector 94, Noida (Noida Expressway (Ultra-luxury)). Sky villas and duplex penthouses, four homes to a tower floor. Price band ₹7 Crore – ₹15 Crore. Status: new launch. Possession: December 2030 (new launch — excavation begins Q1 2027). Suited to: self use, both buyers. Amenities include Private lift lobby for every apartment, Sky lounge on the 40th floor, Infinity pool with Delhi skyline view, Chauffeur lounge and 5-car parking, Concierge, valet and in-residence dining, Wellness floor — spa, salon, physiotherapy, Temperature-controlled corridors, EV charging at every parking bay. Nearby: DND Flyway to South Delhi (8 min), Kalindi Kunj / Okhla (10 min), Magenta Line Metro (Okhla Bird Sanctuary) (7 min), Indira Gandhi International Airport (45 min). Why buyers choose it: Closest Aarambh address to South Delhi — DND is eight minutes away Only 2 residences per floor with a private lift lobby New-launch pricing; the same address resells materially higher today

Aarambh Meadows is a apartment project in Sector 143B, Noida (Noida Expressway). Mid-sized family homes a short walk from the Aqua Line. Price band ₹85 Lakh – ₹1.6 Crore. Status: under construction. Possession: June 2028. Suited to: self use, both buyers. Amenities include 22,000 sq ft clubhouse, Swimming pool and toddler pool, Cricket practice net and half basketball court, Jogging track around a central green, Creche and homework room, Retail plaza inside the gate, Power backup and 2-tier security. Nearby: Aqua Line Metro (Sector 143) (6 min walk), Noida–Greater Noida Expressway (4 min), Advant Business Park (10 min), Genesis & Lotus Valley schools (12 min). Why buyers choose it: One of the few Expressway projects within walking distance of a metro station Efficient layouts — carpet-to-saleable ratio around 66% Schools and business parks both within 12 minutes

Aarambh Urbania is a apartment project in Sector 16B, Noida Extension, Greater Noida West (Greater Noida West). Smart, compact homes for first-time buyers in Greater Noida West. Price band ₹45 Lakh – ₹95 Lakh. Status: new launch. Possession: March 2029 (new launch — construction begins Q4 2026). Suited to: self use, investment, both buyers. Amenities include 18,000 sq ft clubhouse, Swimming pool and kids' splash pad, Multipurpose sports court, Jogging track around the central green, Retail high street within the township, 1 KVA power backup per home, Gated community with CCTV. Nearby: Proposed Metro extension (Sector 16B stop) (Planned, ~5 min), Gaur City Mall (10 min), FNG Expressway (8 min), Noida Sector 62 IT hub (25 min). Why buyers choose it: Low entry ticket — suits a first home or a smaller investment New-launch pricing sits below surrounding resale inventory Larger balconies than typical Noida Extension stock

Aarambh Sunrise Heights is a apartment project in Sector 1, Noida Extension, Greater Noida West (Greater Noida West). Ready-to-move family homes with nothing left to wait for. Price band ₹52 Lakh – ₹1.05 Crore. Status: ready to move. Possession: Ready to move — OC received, families already living here. Suited to: self use, both buyers. Amenities include Operational clubhouse with pool and gym, Landscaped central park, Badminton and basketball courts, Grocery and pharmacy inside the gate, Kids' play area and senior citizens' corner, 100% power backup for common areas, Gated with 3-tier security. Nearby: Gaur City Mall (6 min), FNG Expressway (5 min), Sector 62 Noida (22 min), Yatharth & Kailash Hospitals (10 min). Why buyers choose it: Occupied and running — you can see the actual flat, not a sample one No GST and no construction risk The society already has an operational clubhouse, not a promised one

Aarambh Sports City is a apartment project in Sector 22D, Greater Noida (Greater Noida). Homes built around a cricket ground, a 400 m track and a swim academy. Price band ₹1.1 Crore – ₹2.2 Crore. Status: under construction. Possession: December 2028. Suited to: self use, both buyers. Amenities include Full-size cricket ground with practice nets, 400 m athletics track, Swimming academy with coaching, Indoor sports arena — badminton, TT, squash, Sports medicine and physiotherapy centre, 35,000 sq ft clubhouse, Amphitheatre and party lawn, EV charging and 2-level basement parking. Nearby: Buddh International Circuit (12 min), Pari Chowk (15 min), Aqua Line Metro (Delta 1) (18 min), Noida International Airport, Jewar (25 min), Sharda & Galgotias University (10 min). Why buyers choose it: Genuine sporting infrastructure, not a token court — a full cricket ground and a 400 m track Suits families with children in serious sports training Large layouts for the price compared with Noida sectors

Aarambh Knowledge Park Residency is a apartment project in Knowledge Park V, Greater Noida (Greater Noida). Rental-focused homes in the middle of Greater Noida's university belt. Price band ₹48 Lakh – ₹88 Lakh. Status: ready to move. Possession: Ready to move. Suited to: investment, both buyers. Amenities include Clubhouse with gym and pool, Study lounge and library, High-speed fibre across the society, Cafeteria and tuck shop, Cycle stands and shuttle pickup point, 24x7 security with visitor management. Nearby: Sharda University (5 min), Galgotias University (8 min), Bennett University (12 min), Pari Chowk (10 min), Aqua Line Metro (Knowledge Park II) (9 min). Why buyers choose it: Three large universities within twelve minutes — steady student and faculty tenant demand Ready to move, so it can be let out from the month of registry Low ticket size for a 3BHK

Aarambh Green Acres is a plot project in Yamuna Expressway, Sector 22D, Greater Noida (Jewar Airport Belt). Registry-ready residential plots on the Yamuna Expressway, near Jewar Airport. Price band ₹38 Lakh – ₹1.4 Crore. Status: ready to move. Possession: Immediate registry and possession. Suited to: investment, both buyers. Amenities include Gated plotted township with boundary wall, 40 ft and 60 ft internal roads, Underground electricity and water lines, Central park and community centre, 24x7 security. Nearby: Noida International Airport, Jewar (15 min), Yamuna Expressway access (2 min), Proposed Film City site (20 min), Buddh International Circuit (25 min). Why buyers choose it: Freehold and registry-ready — you own the land outright Plots historically move on infrastructure milestones; Jewar Airport is the trigger here You can build to your own design within the approved FAR

Aarambh Aerocity is a apartment project in Sector 22E, Yamuna Expressway, Greater Noida (Jewar Airport Belt). Apartments built for the airport economy, twelve minutes from Jewar. Price band ₹58 Lakh – ₹1.25 Crore. Status: new launch. Possession: September 2029 (new launch). Suited to: investment, both buyers. Amenities include Clubhouse with pool, gym and cafe, Serviced-apartment block for short stays, Co-working floor, Airport shuttle pickup point, Retail plaza, EV charging and visitor parking, Gated with 3-tier security. Nearby: Noida International Airport, Jewar (12 min), Yamuna Expressway access (3 min), Proposed Film City site (18 min), Proposed Pod Taxi corridor (Planned along YEX). Why buyers choose it: Closest Aarambh residential project to the new airport Includes a serviced-apartment block aimed at airport and crew short stays Launch pricing in a corridor whose infrastructure is still being built out

Aarambh Industrial Park is a commercial project in Sector 32, Yamuna Expressway, Greater Noida (Jewar Airport Belt). Warehousing and light-industrial plots on the freight corridor. Price band ₹1.5 Crore – ₹8 Crore. Status: ready to move. Possession: Immediate registry — construction can begin at once. Suited to: investment buyers. Amenities include 24 m and 18 m internal roads rated for trailers, Dedicated 33 KV substation, Effluent treatment plant, Truck parking and weighbridge, Labour rest facility and canteen, Fire hydrant network, Boundary wall with 24x7 security. Nearby: Noida International Airport cargo terminal (20 min), Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor (25 min), Yamuna Expressway access (4 min), Proposed multi-modal logistics hub (22 min). Why buyers choose it: Industrial land use already approved — no conversion needed Sized for warehousing, light manufacturing and cold storage Airport cargo and the freight corridor are both within 25 minutes

Aarambh Riverside Indirapuram is a apartment project in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad (Ghaziabad). Large family homes in a settled Ghaziabad neighbourhood, close to Delhi. Price band ₹1.3 Crore – ₹2.4 Crore. Status: ready to move. Possession: Ready to move. Suited to: self use, both buyers. Amenities include Clubhouse with pool, gym and banquet hall, Landscaped park and jogging loop, Tennis and badminton courts, Market and schools within walking distance, Two-level basement parking, 100% power backup, Gated with 3-tier security. Nearby: Blue Line Metro (Vaishali) (10 min), NH-24 / Delhi–Meerut Expressway (5 min), Anand Vihar ISBT & railway station (15 min), Shipra Mall / Aditya Mall (6 min), Yashoda & Max Hospitals (8 min). Why buyers choose it: Indirapuram is a settled neighbourhood — schools, markets and hospitals already exist Delhi–Meerut Expressway five minutes away makes East Delhi commutes short Larger built-up areas than comparably priced Noida stock
